tax_litigation.status: In the considered opinion of the Company’s legal counsel, the demand raised by the Hon’ble GST Authority on account of the alleged misclassification of one of the Company’s products is not sustainable in law. Accordingly, the Company filed an appeal against the said order before the appropriate appellate authority on April 25, 2025. The matter was initially listed for hearing on December 29, 2025; however, it was adjourned to January 2, 2026. On the said date, the hearing was again adjourned. Subsequently, the appellate authority, vide its order dated February 26, 2026, partially accepted the Company’s submissions and modified the impugned order to that extent. However, based on the advice of its legal counsel, the Company has decided to further challenge the order passed by the appellate authority before the appropriate forum.
